entries.857b3c81ada61e86: The company manufactures and sells fluid transmissions used in industrial vehicles and construction machinery. This category is not included in the reportable segments, and includes the powertrain business and others, as well as the real estate business.
entries.a64d565f538c3b3f: The company manufactures and sells office furniture, public facility furniture, security products, healthcare-related products, and others. Domestic and overseas affiliated companies share manufacturing, sales, installation and services. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 is the largest of the 3 reportable segments.

entries.de09abc9ef3016d4: The company manufactures and sells display shelving for stores, refrigerated and freezer showcases, store counters, and others. Installation and services are handled by subsidiaries such as Seku Co., Ltd.
